intent: has(parent.aOptionalString): presence of a field one hop across the to-one relation.

plannerDivergence.issue: has() over an omitted attribute: unknown to the planner, absent to check()
plannerDivergence.reason: Before 0.57.0 the planner folds has() to true, so the plan is KIND_ALWAYS_ALLOWED. The per-row check() calls omit parent.aOptionalString where the hop or the field is missing, so check() denies those rows. From 0.57.0 the plan carries the has().

trap: Rows without a parent and rows whose parent lacks aOptionalString (a4, a7, c1) are both denied; testing only the relation grants the second group, testing only the column without the join mishandles the first.
